claim: The CMP_LT image cannot be extended in place with a generalising comparator: one new code flag already fails, and extra data cells fail non-monotonically. The kernel's domain {0,1,2} is a hard ceiling of that image, not a design choice that can be revisited by adding a few cells.

artifact.sha256: recorded in vm_malbolge/evidence/mbir_m2_cf_cmp provenance; not recomputed here

method.description: Same probe shape as e3_lmao_initializer_budget.json, but on the CMP_LT image, which has ten times less headroom. Flags are added as Nop/MovD+Jmp blocks before HALT: with a matching _HIT label; data cells are added at the end of .DATA with U_ targets kept in the same data block.
method.control: the untouched mbir_cmp_lt.hell assembles to 57,511 bytes (headroom 1,538)

data_cells_only.error: HeLL program overlaps with generated initialization code.
Memory usage conflict while generating initialization code.

exact_loop_design.note: the design for the mutual-decrement comparator (a<b iff a reaches zero before b) needs 2 state flags and 2 marker cells

interpretation: On this image, a single new code flag is already fatal: the 1,538-byte headroom cannot absorb the initializer cost of even one flag.

Data cells fail NON-MONOTONICALLY (2 OK, 4 FAIL, 8 OK, 16 FAIL): the failure depends on where the generated initializer lands, not on how many cells are added. So 'a few more cells' is not a safe operation on this image.
Therefore the {0,1,2} domain of CMP_LT is a hard ceiling of that image. Generalising the comparator in place is not a matter of adding cells or flags: the image has to be emitted by another route.
This is the same wall E3 measured on the ALU image, but reached here at a much smaller budget because the comparator image is already 3,180 bytes larger.
what_this_does_not_demonstrate: Whether a from-scratch HeLL rewrite of the comparator would fit (only in-place extension was probed).
Whether the native emitter can express a general comparator (that is the separate experiment recorded in native_cmp_decimal_build.json).
scope_limits: Measured on mbir_cmp_lt.hell with a specific flag/cell shape; other shapes may shift the numbers but not the direction, since the failure at 1 flag is categorical.
consequence: Domain {0,1,2} of CMP_LT/CMP_GT is confirmed as a structural ceiling of those images. The decimal comparator is attempted instead on the native emitter, which has 30,544 free bytes and needs no new code flags.
